name: Your Company
niche: Stainless steel railings, balustrades and structures

seo.title: Your Company — stainless steel and glass railings in Tashkent
seo.description: Handrails, stair and balcony balustrades, glass railings on stainless posts. Own workshop, mirror polish, one-day installation and a 5-year warranty.
seo.answer: Your Company is a workshop in Mirobod making railings and balustrades from AISI 304 stainless steel and glass: stair railings from 650,000 UZS per metre, glass balustrades from 1,450,000 UZS per metre. Free measurement, one-day installation, 5-year warranty. Phone +998 71 200-04-01.

listing.description: A website for a metal fabrication shop making railings and balustrades: chrome shine on the first screen, specs, a catalogue of projects, packages and stages.

sections.title: Metal that reflects your home
sections.subtitle: Railings, balustrades and handrails in AISI 304 stainless steel and toughened glass. Own workshop, mirror polish, installed in a single day.

sections.label: Workshop
sections.title: We make what people touch every day
sections.text: A handrail is the only part of an interior people hold in their hand. So we grind welds until they disappear, round off the ends, fit end caps and fix the posts with chemical anchors. We work with private houses, apartment complexes and restaurants in Mirobod and across Tashkent.

sections.label: Catalogue
sections.title: Prices per metre
sections.intro: We give the exact price after measuring: it depends on height, number of turns and fixing type.

items.title: Stair railing
items.text: Posts and a Ø50 mm handrail with rails or cables. Satin or mirror finish.

items.title: Glass balustrade
items.text: 10 mm toughened glass on point fixings or in a channel.

items.title: Balcony balustrade
items.text: Stainless steel with glass, perforated sheet or bar infill.

items.title: Wall handrail
items.text: For narrow stairs and entrances, with brackets every 80 cm.

items.title: Entrance canopy
items.text: A stainless frame with laminated glass to keep the rain off.

items.title: House in Mirobod
items.text: Glass on point fixings and a mirror-polished handrail running the full height.

items.title: Residence on Shota Rustaveli
items.text: Perforated-sheet balustrades, identical on every floor of the facade.

items.title: Restaurant in Tashkent City
items.text: Satin stainless steel with brass inserts to match the dining room.

items.title: Clinic in Yunusabad
items.text: Two-level handrails along the corridors for patients.

items.label: to install in a flat or house

items.title: Measurement
items.text: A craftsman visits with samples, takes measurements and talks through the job. Free within Tashkent.

items.title: Sketch
items.text: We draw a sketch and price the job. We revise it until you like it, at no extra charge.

items.title: Fabrication
items.text: We cut, bend, forge and weld in our own workshop, sending photos at every stage.

items.title: Finishing
items.text: Metal primer plus powder or forge paint, so the finish does not peel after one season.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We deliver and install in a day, clean up after ourselves and sign the warranty.

items.a: For outdoors we use AISI 304 and passivate the welds. You will not get rust spots; wiping it once a year with a stainless cleaner is enough.
Free within Tashkent. In the region we charge travel, which is then deducted from the order.
Toughened 10 mm or 8+8 laminated. If broken, toughened glass crumbles into blunt pieces.
50% upfront once the sketch is agreed, the rest after installation. Cash, card or bank transfer.
Welds, fixings and geometry for 5 years. If a post works loose, we come and re-fix it free of charge.
